title: Roll Player Adventures
subtitle: A cooperative narrative board game of heroic fantasy, branching quests, and character-driven adventure in the world of Ulos
tagline: Roll your dice, forge your path, and decide the fate of Nalos
loreSummary: Following the brutal Dragul invasion, peace in the Kingdom of Nalos hangs by a thread. As newly minted members of the King's Guard, your party is thrust into a perilous quest across uncharted realms to uncover ancient artifacts, expose sinister conspiracies, and shape the destiny of Ulos.
keyFeatures: 11 branching adventure books packed with consequential narrative decisions and puzzle encounters
Seamless character import from the original Roll Player dice-drafting game or pre-generated heroes
Dynamic dice manipulation and attribute-matching puzzles replacing standard combat luck
Rich fail-forward storyline where setbacks evolve the adventure rather than halting your campaign

rpa_standard.name: Standard Campaign Saga
rpa_standard.description: The complete core storybook narrative traversing the Kingdom of Nalos and beyond across 11 epic adventures.

rpa_extended.name: Campaign Saga & Side Quests
rpa_extended.description: The full 11-part main campaign plus supplemental side questbooks and bonus challenges across ~13 adventures.

rpa_grand_saga.name: Grand Saga (Backstories & Modules)
rpa_grand_saga.description: The definitive experience integrating Nefras's Judgement personal backstory codex quests, character alignments, and extra explorations across ~15 adventures.

milestones.title: Defense of Nalos

milestones.title: Mysteries of the Starlit Door
milestones.phase: Campaign Act II - The Astral Anomaly
milestones.description: Tracking ancient relics and planar rifts as the mysterious Starlit Door cult manipulates events from the shadows of Ulos.
